Re: FB/USAID -COVID response discussion
[contact omitted] Satish Menon Wednesday, June 9, 2021 at 11:34:13 PM Eastern Daylight Time
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Rajat Arora

In addition to the concept note on REVIVE shared earlier, I am sharing brief notes on the work with Sewa Bharat, UNICEF

Lets discuss.

Just sending out an invite for Tuesday morning to discuss this.
Thanks and regards

On Thu, May 27, 2021 at 3:23 PM Rajat Arora q [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Satish,
Adding my colleagues
This sounds interesting, and we'll be happy to explore this conversation further. This week is tight for us in

Best,
From: Satish Menon <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, May 27, 2021 2:50 PM
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Madhu Sirohi < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Priya Naik- [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Co: RohitAingra 2
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Ms Imrana Y. Khera <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: FB/USAID -COVID response discussion
Dear Madhu and Rajat,
Hope you are doing well.
Specific to our conversations on the work Facebook has been doing around COVID related communications, I would
like to connect you to our Implementing Partner for the REVIVE program. Priya leads Samhita Collective Good
Foundation and through the platform called India Protectors Alliance working on vaccine-related awareness,
sensitization, COVID appropriate behavior, vaccine hesitancy etc. One of the corporate partners under the alliance is
HUL which in turn is working with UNICEF around behavioral changecommunication tools targeting COVID.
Connecting the dots to explore further collaborations.
Regards
Satish
USAID/India

On Fri, Apr 30, 2021 at 12:32 PM Satish Menon <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Madhu and Rajat,
Was so great catching up with you over the call.
As we discussed, I am sharing a synopsis of a few COVID-specific programs addressing health and economic
recovery that USAID/India is focusing on.
1) Health Blended Financing Facility: USAID/India in collaboration with several government organizations and
foundations has established a Health blended financing initiative to support the immediate deployment high-impact
solutions such as oxygen delivery systems, cold chain storage solutions for vaccines, low-cost RT-PCR kits, artificial
intelligence for tracing COVID-19 hotspots, precision surveillance diagnostic systems and community- based
interventions to address the second wave of COVID-19 pandemic.
2) REVIVE -Blended Finance Facility supporting livelihoods of informal workers impacted by COVID: The
REVIVE Alliance is supporting the informal sector whose livelihoods are impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, with a
focus on women and youth. The REVIVE Alliance facilitates skills development, technical assistance, vocational
skills, business training, and market linkages to complement the financial support. Launched in October 2020 by
Samhita-Collective Good Foundation and supported by USAID, Omidyar Network India, Michael & Susan Dell
Foundation, British High Commission, the United Nations Development Programme India. The REVIVE Alliance has
also partnered with the Government of India's National Skills Development Corporation program. The Alliance
engages experts from J-PAL South Asia, Georgetown University and the Atlantic Council for a robust monitoring and
evaluations to understand the impact of this blended-finance facility, the largest of its kind to be tested in India.
3) Communications on COVID appropriate behaviors: USAID has been working with UNICEF to support the
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in the development of a comprehensive Communications Strategy
complemented by an array of materials and guides, as well as community mobilization and social media activities
promoting Covid Appropriate Behaviours(CAB) and COVID related stigma and discrimination.
Further, as you mentioned regarding the proposed intervention around health communications, we are open to
exploring the same with WHO.
Shall we set up a follow-up call next week to chat about the concrete next steps?
Best wishes, good health & safety to all,
Satish
Best,
Satish Menon
Development Assistance Specialist (Innovations and Partnerships)
USAID India | Development Partnerships & Innovations Office

Wednesday 3 PM works for us. If that works for you and Madhu, will send out a calendar invite.
Warm Regards
Satish
On Mon, Apr 26, 2021 at 4:44 PM Rajat Arora < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Satish,
Happy to connect with you Satish. We are available day after tomorrow, pls let me know how you
are placed post 1 pm.
Regards,

Rajat Arora

From: Satish Menon <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, April 26, 2021 3:54 PM
To: Rajat Arora < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Nehal Sanghavi <[contact omitted]>
Subject: FB/USAID -COVID response discussion
Hi Rajat,
Hope you are fine and staying safe.
I am Satish Menon from USAID/India's partnerships team. Eittee from FICCI helped me connect with you as I
was searching for our point of contact on the Millennium Alliance side after Shelley and Ankhi.
With a broader context, was keen to have a discussion with you to sync up our COVID response plans and
explore possibilities of interventions where both organizations can work together to counter the current situation.
Would also like to update you on some very initial discussions around this that FB India leadership had with our
Deputy Assistant Administrator of USAID/Asia Bureau.
Would you be available for a quick chat sometime this week? Let me know what time works.
Satish Menon
Development Assistance Specialist (Innovations and Partnerships)
